mutator.name: plan003_uaf_llm01_random_object_value
mutator.strategy: 50% default LLVMFuzzerMutate; 50% mutate one seed-selected group-code-0 value line inside OBJECTS to a Seed-derived random name while preserving group-code digits, line count, CRLF, and ENDSEC.

biases.code_hint: Find OBJECTS via DXF 0/SECTION,2/OBJECTS; scan code-0 records until 0/ENDSEC; pick one by Seed; replace only the following value line with a random alphabet string length 1..64.

limits: Only the frozen a001 action is implemented; no excluded or new feature strategies are added.

OBJECTS locating follows standard DXF pair structure with group-code 2 / value OBJECTS and stops at group-code 0 / value ENDSEC; malformed or non-paired DXF may cause the feature branch to return the original Size without mutation.
DWG format分流 is implemented for leading literal ASCII bytes 'A','C' as stated by the llvmfuzz rule; 0xAC is not additionally treated as DWG.
Replacement values never contain CR/LF because the alphabet excludes them; the existing line ending bytes are left untouched.
